Windows error guide / 0xC004F074

0xC004F074Microsoft

Check organization activation access

Context

Organization-server connectivity or the edition/key context may need investigation.

Checks

  1. Check whether a work or school license manages this PC.
  2. Check the installed edition and the corporate network/VPN specified by IT.

Next action

Consult Microsoft’s activation guidance; contact IT for organization licenses, the maker for preinstalled Windows, or Microsoft Support otherwise.

Sources

  • Microsoft Support ↗
